data.name: C-DAC Python Assignments & Modules
data.description: Comprehensive Python programming assignments, laboratory implementations, data structures, algorithms, and practical problem-solving solutions completed under the C-DAC curriculum.

data.name: BlockBazar - NFT Marketplace
data.description: Built a decentralized NFT marketplace supporting ERC-721 token minting, listing, purchasing, and ownership transfer. Integrated IPFS for decentralized metadata storage and Ethers.js for Ethereum and Polygon blockchain interactions. Applied OpenZeppelin security standards and validated smart contract functionality through Foundry-based testing with reentrancy-safe payment mechanisms.

data.name: Crowdfunding Smart Contract
data.description: Designed and integrated an Ethereum-based crowdfunding smart contract with automated goal validation and refund mechanisms. Built secure fund-handling logic with reentrancy protection and 100% unit/fuzz test coverage using Foundry.

data.name: Stationery Management System
data.description: Developed a Python-based inventory management application for tracking stationery stock and usage. Implemented input validation, stock monitoring, automated low-inventory alerts, and generated inventory history reports.

data.name: Grin & Earn (Blockchain)
data.description: Built an on-chain reward distribution system triggered by emotion-detection outputs. Utilized smart contract logic for transparent reward allocation and transaction tracking with Web3.js for real-time frontend monitoring.
